_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored) beside config.json and fill in. It is deep-merged over config.json at load time; arrays and scalars replace. Never commit the real file.

backup._comment: Snapshots of server/data (hard links, checked, kept 24 hourly / 14 daily / 8 weekly). Everything here is optional. snapshotDir defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%/hfs-monitor/snapshots; everyMinutes 0 = only at start-up; enabled false = none. offsiteDir (off by default) gets one archive a day of the newest good snapshot, the last offsiteKeep (7) kept: a OneDrive folder or another disk. Restore with: node tools/restore-snapshot/restore.mjs list

my-runner.token: the token in ~/.hfs-monitor/runner.json on that machine
